runs-on.description: Single runner label used when runs-on-json is empty. Only arkanis-runners can reach OpenViking.

include-paths.description: Newline-separated globs (GitHub paths filter semantics) selecting tracked docs. Must equal repo-standards OPENVIKING_DOC_GLOBS by default.

target-root.description: OpenViking URI under which the mirror is stored as <target-root>/<repository name>.

max-archive-bytes.description: Fail before uploading when the docs archive is larger than this.

import-timeout-seconds.description: Seconds to wait for OpenViking to finish processing the import.

dry-run.description: Collect and archive docs without contacting OpenViking. Allowed on any ref and event.
